item.title: Seifuku Rakuen Extend
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Digital Lover
  • 発売日: 2010-08-15
  • スコア: 6.26/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 制服楽園EXTEND
  • 英語名: Seifuku Rakuen Extend

あらすじ

Kana, who’s started dating her part-time job junior, Eita, is growing frustrated. It’s been three months, and they haven’t even kissed. The relationship isn’t progressing at all.

Kana has an older brother, but he’s so careless with women that she can’t imagine getting any useful advice from him. Instead, she decides to visit her cousin, who lives nearby, for some relationship counseling.

item.title: School Captain: Kaichou Kouho wa Gorippuku
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Digital Lover
  • 発売日: 2009-08-16
  • スコア: 6.36/10 (18 人評価)
  • 日本語名: SchoolCaptain 会長候補はご立腹
  • 英語名: School Captain: Kaichou Kouho wa Gorippuku

あらすじ

The protagonist, Kira Keisuke, is on the verge of failing the year.

He’s managed to score failing grades in every subject—a grand slam of academic failure.

To avoid repeating the year, his teachers propose a deal: convince his childhood friend, Igarashi Rin, to run for student council president and compete in the National Student Council Competition.
